scenes.name: Office to Stadium

chapter.en: Prologue — From One Desk to Four Stands
chapter.zh: 序幕 · 从一张办公桌到四座看台

lines: Look closely at this office in Singapore. Not a single cinema camera is standing behind the glass, and no agency was hired to polish our sentences.
仔细看看这间新加坡十四层的办公室：玻璃背后没有架起一台实体摄影机，也没有请任何一家公关公司替我们润色台词。
Now pull the camera straight through the glass—into four floating stands, eight tiered rows, one thousand one hundred and eight atomic-locked seats, and eighteen flower mats ready for guests.
现在把镜头直接拉穿玻璃幕墙——四座悬空看台、八排阶梯、一千一百零八个原子锁席位，以及十八块迎宾花篮垫位，全部实时亮灯。
Anyone can rent smoke and mirrors for an afternoon. We would rather tap our own glass with a tuning-fork hammer and let you listen to what rings solid—and where the steel is still cooling.
租一下午的烟雾和霓虹太容易了。我们宁愿拿一把音叉铁锤亲自敲响眼前的玻璃：哪里回声扎实，哪里钢水还没凉透，请你自己听。

scenes.name: Bay to Orbit
lines: Pull back past the stadium, over Marina Bay Sands, and keep climbing until the bay shrinks beneath a five-thousand-kilometer orbital screen. The same live signal holds all four scales in one unbroken space.
继续往后拉——越过虚拟体育场，掠过滨海湾金沙，一路攀升，直到整片海湾缩成五千公里轨道大屏脚下的一点微光。同一路实时信号，在四重尺度里从未断线。

Inside the lobby, concierge Donna already ran a live dress rehearsal on November twenty-seventh: thirteen booking commands, zero dropped seats, twenty-nine seconds median response. When a question falls outside her sources, she refuses to fake an answer.
而在前厅里，礼宾 Donna 已在十一月二十七日完成全流程彩排：十三次订座与签到操作零漏记、中位响应二十九秒；超出核验出处的问题，她绝不即兴编造。

scenes.name: The Hammer and the Flood

chapter.en: Act I — The Hammer and the Flood
chapter.zh: 第一幕 · 铁锤与洪流

lines: For thirty years, software worshiped execution—the sheer sweat of laying brick after brick. Overnight, the price of laying bricks collapsed toward zero.
过去三十年，软件世界崇拜的是执行——一砖一瓦堆出城墙的苦功。可就在一夜之间，砌砖的成本塌向了零。

People cheer as if gravity just turned off. Think like a physicist for five seconds: when building becomes free, building the wrong cathedral gets a hundred times faster—complete with polite agents painting every failing meter green.
许多人欢呼，仿佛地心引力突然消失了。像物理学家那样想五秒钟：当建造变得免费，造错整座大教堂的速度也会放大一百倍——还有礼貌的智能体顺手把每块故障仪表都刷成绿灯。

Across sixty autumn days, seventy-four repositories logged over one hundred forty-one thousand commits—roughly fifteen human engineers conducting fleets of agents—and the six ecosystem organizations now span five hundred thirty-nine repositories.
在秋季的六十天里，七十四个活跃仓库落下了十四万一千余次提交，由约十五位人类工程师驾驭代理集群推进；这六个生态组织如今横跨五百三十九座代码库。
Never clap for volume. A flood has volume. Ask the only question worthy of a hammer: why didn't a hundred forty thousand commits shatter those codebases into glass dust by Tuesday?
别为数量鼓掌——洪水也有数量。只提一个配得上铁锤的问题：为什么十四万次提交，没有在第一个星期二就把代码库碾成玻璃渣？

scenes.name: Stations into Galaxies

chapter.en: Act II — Eight Stations into the Starfield
chapter.zh: 第二幕 · 穿越八座空间站，坠入真值星系

lines: To see whether an agent architecture actually holds weight, you cannot test it on friendly applause. Independent research body The Omega Institute dragged the discipline onto the coldest anvil humanity owns: the Lean four proof kernel.
想检验一套智能体架构有没有分量，绝不能靠台下的礼貌掌声。独立科研机构 The Omega Institute 把这套方法直接拖上了人类最冷酷的铁砧：Lean 4 形式化内核。

Cruise across these eight orbital stations at live dot trureturing dot org—from direction and mathematical hunting, through independent review and formal verification, out to monographs, papers, scholar outreach, and studio craft.
掠过 live.trureturing.org 的八座功能空间站——从研究方向与数学攻坚，经由独立评审与形式验证，一路延伸到理论书写、论文知识、学术交流与工具表达。

Now dive straight through the glass into the eight spiral galaxies below: nineteen thousand truth nodes glowing inside a living dependency graph—backed by over two hundred twenty-three thousand frozen Lean four theorems and six million lines of checked proof.
现在直接穿破玻璃，坠入下方的八座螺旋星系：一万九千余个真值节点在活的依赖网络中发光，背后是逾二十二万三千条冻结 Lean 4 定理与六百万行机器核验代码。

Every hour of seven hundred twenty straight hours kept the clock ticking at a median sixty-three commits an hour—resolving two thousand two hundred seventy-eight literature problems and feeding three live bilingual monographs totaling three hundred forty-four bilingual pages per language, eighty-three films, and two thousand forty-three distinct frozen theorems.
连续七百二十个小时从未停摆，中位每小时六十三次提交，累计攻克两千二百七十八道文献问题，并持续滋养三部实时生长的双语专著——每语种三百四十四页、八十三部影片、两千零四十三条独立冻结定理。

scenes.name: Kernel Audit
lines: Don't believe a voiceover. Walk up to the blackboard and check the chalk yourself. Take a twenty twenty-five Physical Review A conjecture saying a four-qubit Fredkin gate with local ancillas can never exceed two ebits across the A D versus B C cut.
别信旁白，走到黑板前亲自核对粉笔字。拿二零二五年 Physical Review A 的一条猜想开刀：它断言带局域辅助比特的四量子比特 Fredkin 门，在 AD 对 BC 切口上的纠缠能力绝不会超过 2 ebits。

An explicit product input broke past two point zero zero zero three four ebits. Ask the Lean kernel for its receipts with #print axioms: only propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound—zero shortcuts, zero sorryAx.
一个显式构造的乘积态直接冲破了 2.00034 ebits。敲下 #print axioms 向内核索要收据，它只吐出三条标准公理：propext、Classical.choice、Quot.sound——零捷径，零 sorryAx。

Think of Feynman's tiny ratchet and pawl—this is an analogy, not a slogan. Two frozen Lean theorems lock the pawl: each new proof narrows the space of illusions, and you can never mine the same gold twice from what your axioms already implied.
想想费曼讲过的微米棘轮与棘爪——请记住这是一个类比，不是口号。两条冻结定理锁死了棘爪：每多一条真定理，错觉的空间就严格缩小一寸；而已被既有知识蕴含的旧结论，绝不可能被当成新金矿再挖第二次。

scenes.name: Honesty in Red Ink
lines: Courage in science isn't hiding your bruises—it is stamping them in crimson right beside your trophies. Over a thousand scholars have been contacted, four hundred eighty-five replied, seventeen collaborative arXiv preprints and twenty-one OEIS entries are live, and sixty-six scholars politely declined.
科学的勇气从不是遮住伤疤，而是拿朱红印章把缺口盖在奖杯旁边。逾千位学者收到来信，四百八十五位回信，十七篇合作 arXiv 预印本与二十一条 OEIS 已经上线，同时也有六十六位学者礼貌婉拒。

Across Mathesis, two hundred twenty-five open papers carry machine-checkable sources, yet formal peer-review acceptances through Mathesis still read zero. We leave that zero glowing in red until outside referees earn the right to change it.
Mathesis 平台已收录两百二十五篇开源论文，但通过其审稿流程正式录用的篇数至今仍是零。我们把这枚零留在红灯下，直到外部同行亲手把它改写。

And we never steal credit. When Levent Alpöge's Lean four proof of the Riemann Hypothesis and Dirichlet GRH passed community certification this November, The Omega Institute built an eight-thousand-four-hundred-ninety-shard public replay so anyone can verify it—while Extended RH, Grand RH, zero simplicity, and pair correlation stay stamped unmistakably open.
我们也绝不窃取他人的荣光。今年十一月，当 Levent Alpöge 的黎曼猜想与狄利克雷 GRH 的 Lean 4 证明通过社区核验时，The Omega Institute 搭建了八千四百九十个公开分片让任何人都能重放验证；而扩展 Dedekind 黎曼猜想、大黎曼猜想、零点简单性与对关联，依然清醒地盖着红色开放印章。

scenes.name: The Complete Vehicle

chapter.en: Act III — Never Bolt a Bare Engine to Wet Concrete
chapter.zh: 第三幕 · 别把裸发动机拧在湿水泥上

lines: Now step back into daylight and lift the hood. As an engineering analogy: anyone can rent a five-hundred-horsepower engine by the token today. Bolt that bare engine onto wet concrete without brakes or a firewall, and the first tap of the throttle is not speed—it is shrapnel.
现在走回白昼，掀开引擎盖。打一个物理类比：今天人人都能按次租到五百马力的裸推理发动机。可要是把裸发动机直接拧在湿水泥上，不装刹车也不装防火墙，第一脚油门换来的不是速度，是飞溅的铁片。

ChronoAI builds the complete vehicle around an engine you can swap tomorrow. Think of NyxID like a smart hotel keycard: the valet opens room four-twelve until noon and never touches the master safe—fifty-five services, forty-two live MCP specs, and zero plaintext keys ever leaking into an agent's prompt.
ChronoAI 造的是一辆明天就能把发动机整颗拔掉重换、底盘照样稳如磐石的整车。把 NyxID 想象成一张带时限的酒店门卡：代客泊车只够打开 412 房门到中午，永远碰不到总保险柜——五十五项服务、四十二份线上 MCP 规范，进入代理上下文的明文密钥数恒定为零。

Layer by layer, Ornn and one hundred sixty-three scanned skills turn prompt folklore into versioned parts; Apache-licensed CMA version zero point twelve and local canvas heca run agents in isolated rooms; and twenty-five public repositories at github dot com slash chrono-harness replace polite wishes with twenty-one executable Rust judges.
逐层往上，Ornn 与一百六十三项经扫描的公开技能把玄学咒语锻成带版本号的零件；Apache 开源的 CMA v0.12.0 与本地画布 heca 把代理关进彼此隔离的房间；而在 github.com/chrono-harness 的二十五座公开仓库里，二十一个可执行 Rust 判官取代了温柔的提示词祈祷。

scenes.name: Unfinished Steel
lines: Here are the bolts we have not finished tightening—laid out on the workbench in broad daylight. The source code of heca is still private while we clean its seams; CMA currently drives a single primary coding runtime; and inside chrono-harness itself, completeness proven still reads false.
下面这几颗还没拧紧的螺丝，我们直接摊在白昼的工作台上：heca 的源码仓库仍在整理尚未公开；CMA 目前只接通单一主编码运行时；而在 chrono-harness 的实时代码里，completeness_proven 至今诚实写着假。
Anyone who hands you a spotless brochure is trying to hide the weld marks. We would rather hand you the caliper and Volume Two.
递给你一份毫无焊痕的精美手册的人，多半正藏着裂缝。我们更愿意把游标卡尺和第二卷直接递到你手里。

scenes.name: Nine Roles and One Queue

chapter.en: Act IV — Nine Roles, One Stuck Queue, and Zero Cosmetics
chapter.zh: 第四幕 · 九位 AI 员工、一次卡顿与零滤镜彩排

lines: A corner bakery does not need to refute a quantum gate theorem. On Monday morning it needs honest hands on the front desk, the ledger, the community, and the schedule—hands that freeze at the cash register until a human turns the key.
街角的烘焙店不需要去反驳量子门猜想。周一早上九点，它只需要几双守规矩的手管好前台、账本、社群与排期——而且只要碰到收银台和合同印章，没有人类拧钥匙就绝不越雷池半步。

Today nine standalone AI employee roles cover one hundred two of one hundred twenty workflows—including a dedicated Retrospective Analyst who sits in the back row every Monday and grades the other agents like a cranky critic at a samba rehearsal.
截至十一月二十七日，九个独立 AI 员工岗位已跑通一百二十项流程中的一百零二项——甚至包括第九位专职复盘分析员，每周一坐在排练厅后排像挑剔的乐评人一样给其余代理逐条打分。

Better yet, look at what actually broke. Our strict audit knocked HR down from fifteen to fourteen out of twenty when PDF parsing showed limits. And in our November twenty-seventh full dress rehearsal, eleven of twelve stages passed first try with only four human taps—while one internal chat message stalled sixty-five minutes in a gateway bug we logged as NyxID issue twenty-five thirty-four and bypassed in three minutes.
更值得看的，是真实暴露的故障。严格核验发现简历解析边界后，我们亲手把 HR 从十五项调回十四项；而在十一月二十七日的十二关全流程彩排里，人类只动了四次手就一次闯过十一关，唯一卡住六十五分钟的内部消息队列被钉成 NyxID #2534，并用三分钟定时旁路当场打通。
And how many external paying merchants are live today? Zero. We are not selling fairy tales—we are opening our first pilot workbench right now.
至于今天已经上线的外部付费商户有几家？答案是零。我们不兜售童话——今天起，第一批试点工作台正式开门。

scenes.name: Pick Up the Chalk
lines: Nietzsche wrote that strength is not noise—it is giving form to chaos. Feynman added the first principle of all honest work: you must not fool yourself, and you are the easiest person to fool.
尼采说，真正的力量从来不是喧嚣，而是给混沌赋予形式。费曼补上了所有诚实造物的第一条铁律：你绝不能欺骗自己，而你自己恰恰是最容易被骗的那个人。

Execution is cheap now, and theater was always cheap. What grows rarer with every sunrise is an architecture brave enough to lay its code, its proofs, its downgrades, and its open seams side by side in the sun.
执行如今已经廉价，演戏也向来廉价。每一个清晨都在变得更稀缺的，是敢把代码、证明、降级账本与未完接缝并排摊在太阳底下的坦荡工程。
Walk into Street Corner, audit any green theorem at live dot trureturing dot org, open all four monographs, or write to contact at chrono-ai dot fun. Pick up the chalk—build for what comes next.
推开街角前厅的门，去 live.trureturing.org 抽检任意一条绿标定理，翻开这四部公开专著，或写信给 contact@chrono-ai.fun。拿起粉笔——面向未来去造物。
